content.text: Published under ops/webhooks/replay-dlq and linked from the incident playbook index.
Operators currently re-drive failed webhook deliveries by querying the dead-letter queue with ad-hoc scripts.
Write a runbook that covers locating failed deliveries, replaying by delivery id or time window, and verifying partner receipt on example.com sandbox endpoints.
Include rollback steps when a replay storm would exceed partner rate limits.
